info.name: UrbanNexus API Collection
info.description:
Comprehensive Postman collection for the UrbanNexus Spring Boot Backend.

Credentials:
- Admin: username=admin, password=Bhumika@1234
- Resident: username=jane_s, password=pwd123#
- Technician: username=tech_tom, password=pwd123#

Workflow: Run 'Login' first — the test script auto-saves the JWT to {{jwt_token}}.

request.description: Allows any authenticated user (Resident, Technician, SuperAdmin) to change their own password. Requires the correct current password. New password must be at least 6 characters. Returns 400 if currentPassword is wrong.

originalRequest.description: Allows any authenticated user (Resident, Technician, SuperAdmin) to change their own password. Requires the correct current password. New password must be at least 6 characters. Returns 400 if currentPassword is wrong.

request.description: Creates a resident record and a linked login account. The response includes the generated username (name + residentId) and the temporary password (pwd123#). The admin must share these credentials with the resident. New users cannot self-register — all accounts are provisioned by the admin.

originalRequest.description: Creates a resident record and a linked login account. The response includes the generated username (name + residentId) and the temporary password (pwd123#). The admin must share these credentials with the resident. New users cannot self-register — all accounts are provisioned by the admin.

response.name: OK (200)

request.description: Creates a technician record and a linked login account. The response includes the generated username (name + techId) and the temporary password (pwd123#). The admin must share these credentials with the technician. New users cannot self-register — all accounts are provisioned by the admin.

originalRequest.description: Creates a technician record and a linked login account. The response includes the generated username (name + techId) and the temporary password (pwd123#). The admin must share these credentials with the technician. New users cannot self-register — all accounts are provisioned by the admin.
